svg.text: No release measurement of Cs-137 exists for the AGR-1 particles in the sources of the register; no curve, no deviation and no metric is drawn
Fraction of Cs-137 released versus time at temperature: no measurement, no comparison
AGR-1 and AGR-2 report no release of Cs-137 (decision 43): the register holds 0 Cs-137 rows of those programmes.
The register holds 12 Cs-137 rows of the programme JAERI (IAEA (1997)) with the status DATA INCOMPLETE; they are not a release measurement of the AGR-1 particles, their denominator is not
established, and no deviation is formed from them.
The model computes the element caesium without decay (decay is not in the solver yet): it gives the release of the element, not of a nuclide. Figure A draws the registered Cs-137 rows of the
other programme against the caesium curve with the marker of their status; of the 12 Cs-137 rows, 0 support a point comparison.

Model: STRATO BTCS five-layer spherical finite difference, package version 1.0.1, commit 3a0ba1c2894bbb17040e2e60c5fcb2ba10414c2f; registered AGR1-B-M16 geometry; published heating-test diffusion coefficients chosen

by the strato-data selection function (register sets C16-T2 and C16-BUF), evaluated at the test temperature; kernel-only start; constant temperature; decay and generation are not in the solver. This is a numerical
